# Agent Handoff

Capture task context and resume it in another coding agent.

| Maintenance | Dormant |
|---|---|
| Version | 0.2.9 |
| Clients | Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code (legacy) |
| License | MIT |
| Source | [Repository](https://github.com/0langa/agent-handoff-cck) |

**Dormant:** Available as-is, with no planned updates. Existing releases remain installable.

## Example request

> Create a handoff so I can continue this task in Claude Code.

## Requirements

Local Python plugin. The legacy Kimi launcher includes a Windows-specific wrapper.

- Python 3.10 or newer
- uv and Git

## Install

### Codex

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
codex plugin add agent-handoff@0langas-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```shell
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
claude plugin install agent-handoff@0langas-plugins
```

## Setup and use

- Install the plugin and start a new session. Ask it to capture or resume a handoff.
- Handoff records are stored locally under .handoff. The source repository is public; no private-repository authentication is required.

## Legacy Kimi compatibility

Kimi compatibility is retained but is not actively tested. First prepare a [recursive checkout](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#development-checkout). Replace the example path with your checkout.

```text
/plugins marketplace C:\path\to\plugins\kimi-marketplace.json
/plugins install C:\path\to\plugins\plugins\agent-handoff
/reload
```
